description: A pharmacologic class includes a compound, based on FDA NDF-RT annotations distributed through DrugCentral. The class points to the compound it contains. Coverage is limited to Mechanism of Action (MoA), Physiologic Effect (PE), Chemical Structure (CS), and Chemical/Ingredient classes.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources supporting the class membership; the source value is DrugCentral.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp when this class–compound relationship was created.

common_properties.name: license
common_properties.description: License annotation for the relationship: CC BY 4.0.

common_properties.name: unbiased
common_properties.description: False identifies curated, non-high-throughput data rather than unbiased data.

source_contributions.scope: FDA NDF-RT memberships in the MoA, PE, CS and Chemical/Ingredient categories, with a non-null class code and a compound represented in SPOKE. Other pharmacologic class categories and memberships without a corresponding Compound are excluded.
source_contributions.description: DrugCentral supplies class–compound annotations from its pharmacologic classification data. The upstream vocabulary source for the included categories is FDA NDF-RT.
